channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Las Vegas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Las Vegas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Las Vegas
item.description:
“Las Vegas, they're going to be the world's team. Whoever has a franchise in Las Vegas, you are the world's team because it's the one truly tourist destination from people around the world. So you're going to get a lot of people coming from everywhere that are excited about baseball that may not have been exposed to it before. So I think there's a lot of reasons for A's fans and particularly new A's fans in Vegas to be excited. I think they're going to do a lot of great things and the stadium is just insane.”

Mark Cuban on Las Vegas, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
“So, because we can only take on so much at once, the more of the discussion was around Las Vegas.”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, Sep 15, 2026. Source: KOMO.

item.title: Bill Foley on Las Vegas
item.description:
Foley told the Review-Journal last week.

“I was going to run back down to Vegas. I’m out of town right now. I try and get out when the temperature hits 100.”

Bill Foley on Las Vegas, Jul 8, 2026. Source: Las Vegas Review Journal.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
The NBA Board of Governors approved in March to explore expansion in two specific cities: Seattle and Las Vegas.

“The only two cities, at the moment, we’re looking at are Las Vegas and Seattle,”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, Jun 23, 2026. Source: 710 AM ESPN Seattle.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
“What we’ve made clear to our teams, we’ve at least specifically said it’s Las Vegas and Seattle. “We’re looking at some other great cities that are interested in having franchises. We’re focused on those two right now. We could decide ultimately to go to new cities. One or two bids are being solicited at this time. The groups are coming together, talking to bankers, talking to the league office, and I think what we’ve said, in fairness to everyone, let’s make a decision by the end of this calendar year, at the latest.”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, Jun 23, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bill Foley on Las Vegas
item.description:
“Las Vegas has earned its place among the great sports cities in America, and an NBA team belongs here,”

Bill Foley on Las Vegas, Jun 22, 2026. Source: KTNV Las Vegas.

item.title: Warren LeGarie on Las Vegas
item.description:
Warren LeGarie:

“Every time you count Vegas out, it beats your ass no matter what. It’s a place where you think, ‘You can’t build another hotel.’ Then it builds another hotel. ‘It can’t host another pro team.’ Then it hosts another pro team. It’s the proverbial “they can.”

Warren LeGarie on Las Vegas, Mar 29, 2026. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: Jerome Williams on Las Vegas
item.description:
He says Vegas has a fan base that may not exist in other places.

“It ushers in the Euro League. Las Vegas is really going to be able to be a hub for the Europeans to really want to, you know, establish their teams and connect with the NBA.So I think Adam Silver has a huge play here that no one's even thinking about,”

Jerome Williams on Las Vegas, Mar 27, 2026. Source: News 3 Las Vegas.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Las Vegas
item.description:
On Cooper Flagg:

“Since we selected him, he’s been everything we thought he’d be and even more. Tremendous kid on and off the court. Here’s a good story for you: He shot like crap in his first game here (Las Vegas). Second game he dominated. We had a plan to play only two games. Cooper comes to the us and the coaches and asks to play a third game. We laughed and told him, ‘No. You’re good.’And he goes, ‘I just don’t want people to think the good game was a fluke.’ All we could do was laugh, but it shows how much he wants to be great,”

Cooper Flagg on Las Vegas, Jul 22, 2025. Source: Spotrac.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
But he did make note again of the two markets regularly mentioned when expansion talk comes up.

“Look, obviously, I know there’s tremendous interest in Seattle. I know there’s tremendous interest in Las Vegas and several other cities as well, whether I’ve read about the interest or have heard indirectly from others,”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, May 15, 2025. Source: Seattle Times.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
After that meeting, the NBA would look to get a sense of what markets might be interested in landing an expansion franchise.

“Obviously I know there’s tremendous interest in Seattle, I know there’s tremendous interest in Las Vegas and several other cities as well,”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, May 14, 2025. Source: Las Vegas Review Journal.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Las Vegas
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on Las Vegas:

“In probably 1-3 years there's going to be a team in Vegas so we're going to come here more often. For me, it's fun because I don't leave my room but I have fun, the weather is good and I'm able to get In-N-Out Burger whenever I come here.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Las Vegas, Dec 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: LeBron James on Las Vegas
item.description:
“It's a small sample. Everyone is getting so cracked up about Vegas and keep bringing up Vegas. It was two games. We took care of that business. It was the in-season tournament, we played it, we won it. But that was literally just two games.”

LeBron James on Las Vegas, Jan 6, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tim Leiweke on Las Vegas
item.description:
Still, that doesn’t mean the company is oblivious to what doors a new arena in Las Vegas may open.

“There’s a lot of people that I know of that want to buy an NBA franchise if one becomes available in Las Vegas,”

Tim Leiweke on Las Vegas, Dec 7, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
“We have a long track record in Vegas. Not that it's a competition, but before those other teams you mentioned were there, we played an All-Star game there. We brought our summer league to Las Vegas. Obviously now we have the WNBA Las Vegas Aces which are incredibly successful there. We're bringing the in-season tournament semifinals and championship game there. So we like the market.”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, Dec 6, 2023. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Adam Silver on Las Vegas
item.description:
Silver was asked directly about Las Vegas as a potential expansion city, and he confirmed that will be under consideration.

“Well, number one, I'll say there are no inside candidates. Lots of players, former players, well-known wealthy people out there who've expressed interest in having a Las Vegas franchise. What I've said to everyone, publicly and privately, is that there is no process in place. There have been no secret discussions, no commitments to anyone. I'm obviously thrilled that people are interested,”

Adam Silver on Las Vegas, Dec 6, 2023. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Jon Krawczynski on Las Vegas, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski on Karl-Anthony Towns:

“He he said it several times, both publicly and privately as well as that he could just feel that that calf was not where it needed to be. And when I caught up with him in Las Vegas, he said that he was feeling fully healthy again, for the first time since before he was injured.”

Jon Krawczynski on Las Vegas, Karl-Anthony Towns, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Las Vegas
item.description:
Jerry Colangelo told Yahoo Sports.

“And I think you just hit on a couple of markets that make the most sense, [Seattle and Las Vegas].”

Jerry Colangelo on Las Vegas, Feb 19, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Floyd Mayweather on Las Vegas
item.description:
Floyd Mayweather didn’t deny the possibility of seeking ownership for a potential team in either Las Vegas or Seattle as well as an existing team.

“It could be the Vegas franchise. It could be the Seattle franchise or I could be buying a franchise that’s already up and running,”

Floyd Mayweather on Las Vegas, Dec 4, 2022. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Las Vegas
item.description:
World Peace told The Sporting Tribune.

“I think you have to somehow involve the Maloofs. I think the Maloofs set the tone for Las Vegas.”

Metta World Peace on Las Vegas, Nov 8, 2022. Source: The Sporting Tribune.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Las Vegas
item.description:
“My team is respectfully and humbly interested in everything that’s happening in Las Vegas and we are going to continue to pursue it.”

Metta World Peace on Las Vegas, Nov 8, 2022. Source: The Sporting Tribune.

item.title: Rich Kleiman on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Las Vegas
item.description:
Kleiman praised LeBron James as a trailblazer and said he and Durant have already put feelers out there.

“I think if LeBron is able to get into Vegas and then you see D-Wade in Utah, I think that only probably opens up the runway even moreso for Kevin having an opportunity to do that,”

Rich Kleiman on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Las Vegas, Nov 7, 2022. Source: Insider.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Las Vegas
item.description:
Silver told Andrews on NBA Today.

“Obviously Michael Jordan is the owner of Charlotte…its great for theecosystem. I’m thrilled that LeBron aspires to be an NBA team owner one day. Las Vegas specifically will make a great location for a franchise one day. We have the WNBA team there, the Aces, that obviously just won the championship.”

Adam Silver on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Las Vegas, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Oscar De La Hoya on Las Vegas
item.description:
“I hear that the NBA may possibly go into town,and so maybe we can join up and become a powerhouse there and help bring the team to the home that we built. We built Las Vegas - literally.”

Oscar De La Hoya on Las Vegas, Jul 29, 2022. Source: The Score.

item.title: Trendon Watford on Las Vegas
item.description:
Portland Trail Blazers’ Trendon Watford on 2022 Las Vegas Summer League title:

“In my head, I was already dreaming about that [champagne].It’s going to be another one of these [rings], though. It’s going to be another one of these in Portland, soon.”

Trendon Watford on Las Vegas, Jul 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Randy Livingston on Las Vegas
item.description:
“The first place they take the rookies is to Las Vegas for summer league. Hopefully, I can talk to them in Vegas or at the rookie symposium,”

Randy Livingston on Las Vegas, Nov 9, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Warren LeGarie on Las Vegas
item.description:
“The people in Vegas, I think when you bring it up there, there’s a source of pride that this is one of their own. It isn’t an event that they bought or had to pay a rights fee to come in; this is something that they initially helped create and sustain. And look, a good portion of the fans are Vegas fans; they’re from Vegas. That part has been terrific for us.”

Warren LeGarie on Las Vegas, Aug 8, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jay Bloom on Las Vegas
item.description:
When reached for comment, Jay Bloom said,

“While it is most certainly too preliminary to comment on our group’s efforts, Bill Foley’s extraordinary success with the Vegas Golden Knights, together with Mark Davis’s Las Vegas Raiders’ incredibly warm reception by the community and his exceptional world class facilities, and further, the addition of the WNBA’s Las Vegas Aces, clearly demonstrate that Las Vegas is already a major player in the world of professional sports.”

Jay Bloom on Las Vegas, Jun 3, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jorge Garbajosa on Las Vegas
item.description:
“When our colleagues from the American Basketball Federation called me to express their interest in our national team participating in the bubble of Las Vegas, from his words I was able to get the acknowledgment of what our name represents – a team that makes the tournaments to which it is invited bigger. This is the best match that world basketball can program, the match between numbers 1 and 2 of the FIBA ​​World Ranking,”

Jorge Garbajosa on Las Vegas, May 5, 2021. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Las Vegas
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“OK, maybe you can make that argument that it is. But it always comes down to, is there some incremental value? Like, having somebody in Vegas, having a team in Seattle, as an example. Will we increase the pie big enough to more than compensate the money that we’re giving them?“ … I’m not saying it’s not possible. I kind of like the idea at a lot of levels, because I think Seattle would add incremental value in different ways.”

Mark Cuban on Las Vegas, Dec 24, 2020. Source: Seattle Times.
